name: Triumph Bonneville T120
engine: 1200 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: The modern liquid-cooled Bonneville. Several recalls, so run the VIN first.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. T120 recalls include sticking throttle with heated grips (2016-2017, 17V035), clutch cable routing (2016-2019, 19V133), a loose left front brake disc (2023, 23V146) and a wiring and charging recall (2022-2024, 26V078).
A-002.reason: Several of these affect brakes or throttle. Repairs are free.

recalls.what: Left front brake disc may be loose and can detach.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the damper and disc bolts free.

recalls.what: Heated grips can expand and make the throttle stick open.
